button.name: activate_payments
button.invisible: batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct' or account_online_link_payments_requested or account_online_link_payments_activated

button.name: initiate_payment
button.invisible: batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct' or not account_online_link_payments_activated or state != 'draft' or payment_online_status != 'uninitiated'

button.name: validate_batch_button
button.invisible: not account_online_link_payments_enabled or state != 'draft' or payment_online_status not in ['uninitiated'] or batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct'

button.name: initiate_payment
button.invisible: not account_online_link_payments_enabled or state == 'draft' or payment_online_status != 'unsigned' or batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct'

button.name: export_batch_payment
button.invisible: not account_online_link_payments_enabled or state == 'draft' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct'

div.invisible: batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct' or not account_online_link_payments_requested or account_online_link_payments_activated

xpath.div: Your payment activation is pending, please wait!

field.name: payment_online_status
field.invisible: state == 'draft' or not account_online_link_payments_enabled or payment_online_status == 'uninitiated'

field.name: payment_online_status
field.invisible: not account_online_link_payments_enabled or batch_type != 'outbound' or payment_method_code != 'sepa_ct'
